correctness.rationale: Polarization converts the SL2 two-sum condition into tr(U^{-1}A)=detA. Rank-one residue sections have q(q-1) solutions and two-dimensional smooth lifts at each depth; primitive invertible sections are controlled by a separable quadratic, yielding q(q±1) residue solutions and q² lifts per layer. All nonprimitive cases are strictly above the claimed minimum by explicit valuation formulas or smooth lower bounds; zero gives the full group. Min-target counting and exact mixing normalization are verified algebraically. Four complete finite exhaustive tests and five further nonreduced F4-target checks succeeded; these are supporting computations, not substitutes for the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact optimal additive minorization for two uniform determinant-one summands over every nilpotent length is a natural quantitative invariant beyond existence. Sharp equality strata expose characteristic-two absolute-trace behavior, and their exact uniform-in-length density supports finite-ring random-walk and sumset analysis. It provides a substantive all-depth classification rather than a single small-ring recomputation, while crediting the known numerical coefficient from the odd-prime analogue.
